description: This file contains machine-specific configuration for ARM architecture, including tuning features, compiler arguments, package architecture overrides, and inclusion of other configuration snippets, specifically for the 'armv7ve' and related variants. It defines various hardware feature flags, compilation instructions, and architecture-specific parameters used during build configuration.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: Utility method used to check if a variable contains a certain value, used here to conditionally append configuration options based on feature flags.
